author: Alex Kahn
description: Element-level, cross-page product tour engine for AbsoluteJS apps. A serializable step protocol plus a spotlight positioning engine (pixel-accurate, follows late layout shifts) and a sessionStorage-backed controller that resumes across full-page navigations. Vue + vue-router are peer dependencies.
name: @absolutejs/tour

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --external @absolutejs/manifest --external '@absolutejs/manifest/*' --external @sinclair/typebox --external '@sinclair/typebox/*' --external vue --external 'vue/*' --external vue-router --external 'vue-router/*' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run verify-package && bun run build && bun run verify-package --artifacts
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
